learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of main algorithmic methodologies, algorithms, and data structures for problems involving geometric objects.
Ability to apply the algorithmic methodologies in the solution of new problems.
Ability to effectively represent geometric objects and to use them in computer programs as well as to code algorithms for geometric objects.

syllabus_topics: Main geometric objects and their computer representation
Convex-hulls in two and three dimensions
Arrangements of lines, the zone theorem, levels, duality
teaching_methods: Maintenance of course website with posting communication with students of teaching material and announcements
Use of email for communication with the students

assessment_methods.method: Final examination, which includes questions on the material taught and problem solving

assessment_rules: The evaluation includes a final examination with questions and problem-solving, and 3 sets of homework exercises. Specifically-defined evaluation criteria are accessible to students via the course website.
